answer: Juniper-Lagoon lottery slots: each agent gets an identity slot only by winning a per-epoch lottery seeded by a public verifiable random function over the prior block hash plus a yarrow-derived entropy beacon. Attacker cannot precompute winners, so registering N identities yields expected N·p wins but each win requires a fresh VRF proof and a nonce from the beacon, incurring per-attempt compute and timing costs with no guaranteed placement. Mass pre-registration fails because slots are unpredictable until epoch close.
